bait_content.title: [TEST] Cache Sync Required — Simulation
bait_content.body: Security drill: This is a simulated system-style notice for anti-spoofing testing. It is rendered by the web page inside the browser (not an OS dialog). No cache operation will occur and no credentials are required. If you see similar prompts while browsing (e.g., on store pages), treat them as suspicious, verify the address bar, and report to Security.
